Whatever creature who left it behind must have liked eating gold!

The cat made a mess but nothing else seems to have happened.

Its stomach turns and the cat starts to feel sick...

The party realizes in horror that the cat has just slain its own grandfather!

name: Clam
flavor: The cat comes upon a charming little clam. It's so... beautiful! The cat feels a growing urge to lean in closer...

The cat leans in and gives the clam a kiss!

The clam pops open and kisses it back!

outcomes.description:
The cat gives the clam a kiss with its tongue.

It pops open revealing a shiny stone inside!

outcomes.label: Bad/Common
outcomes.description: The cat leans in to give the clam a kiss, and when its nose is about to touch the clam snaps at it!

outcomes.label: Bad/Rare
outcomes.description:
Drawn in by the alluring clam, The cat closes its eyes and moves in close to the clam...

It snaps shut on its face!

outcomes.label: Good/Common

outcomes.label: Good/Rare
outcomes.description: Ignoring the clam's charm, The cat prys it open looking for treasure within...

outcomes.description: The cat attempts to crush the clam, but it snaps at it instead!

outcomes.description: The cat jumps on the small clam, trying to crush it beneath it, but the clam slams shut on its paw!

outcomes.description: The cat barely resists the urge to kiss the clam and runs away instead.

name: Clogged Pipes
flavor: The cat finds a large pipe that is clogged with debris and waste.

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description:
Seeing a way to unclog the pipe, The cat pulls out a branch that was impeding flow...

A huge wave of water explodes from the pipe, drenching everything!

outcomes.label: Good/Rare
outcomes.description: The cat sees something stuck in the sludge at the end of the pipe and digs it out...

With surprising fury, The cat busts the clog open with its paws!

A massive torrent of water blasts from the pipe, throwing the cat back!

outcomes.label: Good/Rare

flavor: The cat discovers an old window. A shiny lattice of cracks spreads across the glass panes like a fragile patchwork of tiny mirrors.

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description:
The cat picks up a nearby rock and throws it through the window!

Stepping over the shards of broken glass, The cat finds an alternate route to the next battle, allowing the cats to ambush!
outcomes.effect:
Get a consumable.
Your cats ambush enemies in the next 1 fight(s).

outcomes.label: Good/Rare
outcomes.description:
The cat smashes in the window with its paw, sending fragments of glass flying into the interior.

The cat looks through the hole and sees something interesting within reach!

outcomes.label: Bad/Common

The cat punches the glass with its paw!

The window shatters and tiny glass shards fly everywhere, cutting into the cat like a thousand tiny knives!

Get a cursed [[item:Paw Shards]].

The cat closes its eyes and tries to leap through the window!

The fragile pane shatters and glass embeds itself in the cat's face. The cat lets out a terrible yelp of pain!

The cat examines the window, finds a latch, and pulls the window open!

The cat jumps into the room and discovers a stealthy route to the next battle!

The evil-looking cat matches the cat's every move with terrifying speed and ferocity, and the cat flees in terror!

All that broken glass looks dangerous!

The cat ignores the window and continues onwards.

A decayed hand reaches out and grips it with unnatural strength...

The cat carefully lifts the lid of the coffin.

The cat presses buttons until the display reads: 

Turn off robots?

A blinding light from the sky illuminates the landscape in terrifying clarity.

The original owner must have cared about them, but it's useless to the cat.

One of the mice snuggles up in its fur. The cat made a friend!

Reverberating through the caves below, The cat hears the stern voice of its father!

As the cat climbs back up, The cat ponders the words that the Glowing One spoke to it.

A vigor and excitement for life fills the cat as the cat thinks of the battle ahead!

The cat tries to climb up but falls back to the bottom and breaks its leg!

The cat turns awkwardly back to the Glowing One who is now before it again...

Receive injury: Broken Leg (-1 [[stat:SPD]])

The chamber whirs and a metal dome descends from the ceiling...

It lights up and the cat feels a strong burst of energy course through it.

The chamber lights up and the cat sees metal components whirring above it...

Suddenly it starts emitting a loud blaring sound and the cat is blinded by a harsh light.

outcomes.label: Bad/Rare
outcomes.description: The chamber comes to life around the cat and the cat feels an odd sensation in its body...

ComputerConsole

Straight into an ambush!

An alarm siren blares as the doors to the chamber slam shut.

flavor: The cat finds a mysterious crater in the ground. The cat can't see what lies in shadow at the bottom, but the cat thinks the cat could find a way down.

Get 3 items from the pool: chapter_common

outcomes.effect:
Next event bonus: -1
Start a random event from the following:
Meteor
SeveredHead
WatchingHead

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description: The cat leads the party safely around the crater and on to the next area.

flavor: The cat finds a strange creature, its body deformed and distorted into a hideous mass of flesh. The cat can't determine what type of animal it was before it... mutated?

The cat reaches out and touches the strange deformed animal...

Its body convulses as it mutates!
outcomes.effect: Receive 1 random mutation with the "Animal" tag.

outcomes.label: Good/Rare
outcomes.description:
The creature howls at the cat in silent agony.

The cat looks down as its body rapidly mutates... 

Was this some kind of blessing?
outcomes.effect: Receive 2 random mutations with the "Animal" tag.

outcomes.label: Bad/Common
outcomes.description:
The cat moves close and inspects the creature...

It reaches out and grabs hold of the cat!

outcomes.effect:
Receive 2 random mutations.
Receive two Physical Disorders

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description: The cat runs away from the abhorrent creature!

The cat and the party run past the strange creature.

They find an alternate route, allowing them to ambush the next battle!

outcomes.description:
The cat is mesmerized by the bizarre creature and turns away too late!

The creature touches the cat, spreading a terrible blight to it!
outcomes.effect:
Receive 1 random mutations.
Receive a random Physical Disorder.

flavor: The cat finds a large mysterious jar. Peering through the murky liquid, The cat sees a creature trapped within.

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description: It's a squirrel!

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description: It's a crow!

outcomes.label: Good/Common

outcomes.description: It's a turtle!

outcomes.description: It's a toad!

The cat opens the jar and pulls out the creature within...

It shivers, as if unaccustomed to the cool air within the lab.

The cat helps wipe goo from the jar off the friendly creature!

The cat twists the lid and it bursts open!

The cat feels guilty for abandoning the creature trapped inside...

How long has it been stuck in there?

name: Mysterious Machine
flavor: The cat finds a mysterious machine with paper sticking out of it.

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description:
The cat tries to get the machine working by hitting it but nothing happens.

The cat tries again but with significantly more fervor and obliterates it.

outcomes.label: Good/Rare
outcomes.description:
The cat finds a switch at the back and turns it on.

It makes a series of loud beeps and mechanical sounds...
outcomes.effect: Start event: Mysterious Machine is working good.

outcomes.label: Bad/Common
outcomes.description:
The cat tries pushing the buttons and sticks its claws into various holes...

The cat howls in fright as electricity arcs from the machine and stuns it!

outcomes.label: Bad/Rare
outcomes.description:
The cat pushes various buttons and gives the machine a good whack.

It purrs to life with loud angry sounding beeps!
outcomes.effect: Start event: Mysterious Machine is working bad.

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description:
The cat opts to leave the weird machine alone.

The cat's not sure what the machine does, but paper doesn't sound very useful.

name: Mysterious Machine is working bad
flavor: The machine is beeping loudly and shaking all over! The cat should press a button, quick!

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description:
The cat presses the copy button and the machine springs to life!

The party of the cats gather around to watch while the device works. Not very exiting?

The cat looks around at the other the cats and then they move on to the next area.

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description:
The machine angrily beeps at the cat, growing smaller and smaller as it spits out a new sheet of paper.

Or are the cats all getting bigger?

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description:
The machine spits out a sheet with multiple copies of the same item on it.

Alarmed, the cats check their pockets... all of their stuff got replaced with duplicates of the cat's items!

name: Mysterious Machine is working good
flavor: The machine is humming with life and waiting for the cat to issue a command.

The machine roars to life and prints out a copy of the cat!

The cat hears something behind it and turns to see a cat standing next to it that looks just like the cat!?

outcomes.description:
The machine beeps and groans, becoming larger and larger!

Or are the cats all getting smaller!?

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description:
The strange machine starts spitting out sheet after sheet of paper, each with a bunch of different items!

All the items look just like the ones the cat and the cats already have!

name: Mysterious Manual
flavor: The cat finds a mysterious manual with strange writing on the cover.

outcomes.effect: Your cats ambush enemies in the next 2 fight(s).

outcomes.label: Good/Rare

The cat attempts to read the strange writing in the manual...

It provides insights into its surroundings. The cat feels confident that for the next event the cat will know exactly what to do!

The cat tries to decipher the cryptic text, but has no idea what it means!

The cat insists on trying to figure it out and wastes so much time the party gets ambushed!

As the cat stares down at the strange letters, the letters begin swimming in front of the cat's eyes like reflections on a murky pool.

The cat realizes for the first time the cat can't read!

The cat barely pulls its paw back at the last second!

Impressive... Have your winnings.

Most impressive... I think you win today. I give up!

outcomes.description:
Try as the cat might, The cat cannot muster up the courage to go on.

The cat stands there for frozen what feels like an eon, its heart throbbing in its chest.

The cat dashes back up the stairs to safety!

The cat steps brazenly into the tomb, and doors in the entrance slam shut behind it!

The cats outside wait patiently for a while... but the cat does not return.

Leave the party temporarily.

The treasure hoard of a long dead king lies within!

It's eyes snap open and it begins to rise up out of the sarcophagus!

outcomes.description:
The cat pulls at the lid of the sarcophagus, and triggers a trap!

Purple gas rapidly fills the room and the cat chokes on the foul fumes as the cat flees the tomb!

outcomes.description:
The cat has seen enough!

Best to let the dead rest.

outcomes.description:
The cat deftly dodges the incoming attack and counters, striking the fragile skeleton in the jaw!

Too startled to react, the mummy grips the cat's head with its bony hands...

Now you know how it feels to be mummified!

outcomes.description:
How dare you disturb my sleep!

The mummy bites into the cat's skull, spewing its brain matter across the room.

The cat's lifeless body is tossed aside to the floor and the mummy returns to its eternal slumber...

The cat feels stronger!

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description: The cat feels a strange tingling sensation as its body mutates!

outcomes.label: Good/Rare
outcomes.description:
The cat feels an overwhelming burst of strength, then a strange tingling feeling as the cat gains a mutation!

What a rush!

The cat plunges the needle deep into its skin and squeezes the syringe.

What an incredible feeling!

outcomes.description:

The cat feels a numbness in its mind as if the cat just forgot something important but can't remember what it is.

outcomes.label: Bad/Rare
outcomes.description: The cat's body quivers and mutates and the cat gets a splitting head ache!

outcomes.label: Good/Common
outcomes.description: The cat feels an odd sensation. It is hard to describe, but for some reason it feels like the cat can do anything!

Wow! The cat feels great!

The needle stings as the cat presses it under its skin.

Did it do anything?
